1	/-

     4	Authors: The AlgebraicJacobian Contributors
     5	-/
     6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0FiniteStageChartBaseChange
     7	
     8	/-!
     9	# Naturality of affine scalar extension
    10	
    11	For an algebra map A -> B, base change carries Spec B -> Spec A to the
    12	contravariant Spec of the scalar-extended algebra map.  The tensor factors are
    13	ordered with the extension ring on the left, matching the finite-stage Picard
    14	ring comparisons.
    15	-/
    16	
    17	set_option autoImplicit false
    18	
    19	universe u
    20	
    21	open CategoryTheory Limits TensorProduct
    22	open scoped TensorProduct
    23	
    24	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    25	
    26	noncomputable section
    27	
    28	namespace Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage
    29	
    30	variable (R K A B : Type u)
    31	variable [CommRing R] [CommRing K] [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    32	variable [Algebra R K] [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B]
    33	
    34	/-- The affine base-change isomorphism with the extension ring as the left
    35	tensor factor. -/
    36	noncomputable def affineBaseChangeIso :
    37	    pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R A)))
    38	        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R K))) ≅
    39	      Spec (.of (K ⊗[R] A)) :=
    40	  pullbackSymmetry _ _ ≪≫ pullbackSpecIso R K A
    41	
    42	@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
    43	theorem affineBaseChangeIso_inv_fst :
    44	    (affineBaseChangeIso R K A).inv ≫ pullback.fst _ _ =
    45	      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
    46	        (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight :
    47	          A →ₐ[R] K ⊗[R] A).toRingHom) := by
    48	  simp [affineBaseChangeIso]
    49	
    50	@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
    51	theorem affineBaseChangeIso_inv_snd :
    52	    (affineBaseChangeIso R K A).inv ≫ pullback.snd _ _ =
    53	      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
    54	        (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom :
    55	          K →+* K ⊗[R] A)) := by
    56	  simp [affineBaseChangeIso]
    57	
    58	/-- Base change of an affine morphism over Spec R. -/
    59	noncomputable def affineBaseChangeMap (phi : A →ₐ[R] B) :
    60	    pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R B)))
    61	        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R K))) ⟶
    62	      pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R A)))
    63	        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R K))) :=
    64	  pullback.map _ _ _ _
    65	    (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom phi.toRingHom)) (𝟙 _) (𝟙 _)
    66	    (by
    67	      rw [Category.comp_id, ← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
    68	      congr 2
    69	      exact phi.comp_algebraMap.symm)
    70	    (by simp)
    71	
    72	@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
    73	theorem affineBaseChangeMap_fst (phi : A →ₐ[R] B) :
    74	    affineBaseChangeMap R K A B phi ≫ pullback.fst _ _ =
    75	      pullback.fst _ _ ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom phi.toRingHom) := by
    76	  unfold affineBaseChangeMap
    77	  exact pullback.lift_fst _ _ _
    78	
    79	@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
    80	theorem affineBaseChangeMap_snd (phi : A →ₐ[R] B) :
    81	    affineBaseChangeMap R K A B phi ≫ pullback.snd _ _ =
    82	      pullback.snd _ _ := by
    83	  unfold affineBaseChangeMap
    84	  rw [pullback.lift_snd]
    85	  simp
    86	
    87	set_option maxHeartbeats 12800000 in
    88	-- Both pullback projections expand tensor-product universal maps.
    89	/-- The affine base-change isomorphisms intertwine a base-changed morphism with
    90	the Spec of its scalar extension. -/
    91	theorem affineBaseChangeIso_naturality (phi : A →ₐ[R] B) :
    92	    affineBaseChangeMap R K A B phi ≫ (affineBaseChangeIso R K A).hom =
    93	      (affineBaseChangeIso R K B).hom ≫
    94	        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
    95	          (AlgebraicJacobian.scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom
    96	            (R := R) (K := K) phi).toRingHom) := by
    97	  rw [← cancel_epi (affineBaseChangeIso R K B).inv]
    98	  simp only [Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
    99	  rw [← cancel_mono (affineBaseChangeIso R K A).inv]
   100	  simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id]
   101	  apply pullback.hom_ext
   102	  · rw [Category.assoc, affineBaseChangeMap_fst]
   103	    simp only [Category.assoc]
   104	    rw [affineBaseChangeIso_inv_fst_assoc (R := R) (K := K) (A := B)]
   105	    rw [affineBaseChangeIso_inv_fst (R := R) (K := K) (A := A)]
   106	    rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
   107	    rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
   108	    congr 2
   109	  · rw [Category.assoc, affineBaseChangeMap_snd]
   110	    simp only [Category.assoc]
   111	    rw [affineBaseChangeIso_inv_snd (R := R) (K := K) (A := B)]
   112	    rw [affineBaseChangeIso_inv_snd (R := R) (K := K) (A := A)]
   113	    rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
   114	    congr 2
   115	    ext x
   116	    simp [AlgebraicJacobian.scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom]
   117	
   118	end Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage
   119	
   120	end
   121	
   122	end AlgebraicGeometry

     5	-/
     6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0FiniteStageRestrictionBaseChange
     7	
     8	/-!
     9	# The overlap component of finite-stage Picard base change
    10	
    11	The overlaps produced by `Scheme.Pullback.gluing` are nested pullbacks.  We first
    12	flatten that categorical presentation, using the certified pullback presentation of
    13	the original overlap, and then apply the existing affine overlap comparison.
    14	-/
    15	
    16	set_option autoImplicit false
    17	
    18	universe u
    19	
    20	open CategoryTheory Limits TensorProduct
    21	open scoped TensorProduct
    22	
    23	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    24	
    25	noncomputable section
    26	
    27	/-- Flatten the nested pullback obtained by first base-changing `U` and then
    28	intersecting it with `V`.  The only input about `W` is its displayed pullback
    29	presentation as `U ×_X V`. -/
    30	noncomputable def nestedPullbackFlatteningIso
    31	    {U V X Y Z W : Scheme.{u}}
    32	    (iU : U ⟶ X) (iV : V ⟶ X) (f : X ⟶ Z) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    33	    (a : W ⟶ U) (b : W ⟶ V)
    34	    (hab : a ≫ iU = b ≫ iV)
    35	    (hW : IsLimit (PullbackCone.mk a b hab)) :
    36	    pullback (pullback.fst (iU ≫ f) g ≫ iU) iV ≅
    37	      pullback (a ≫ iU ≫ f) g := by
    38	  let e : W ≅ pullback iU iV :=
    39	    hW.conePointUniqueUpToIso (pullback.isLimit iU iV)
    40	  have e_inv_fst : e.inv ≫ a = pullback.fst iU iV := by
    41	    change e.inv ≫ (PullbackCone.mk a b hab).fst = _
    42	    exact IsLimit.conePointUniqueUpToIso_inv_comp hW
    43	      (pullback.isLimit iU iV) WalkingCospan.left
    44	  exact
    45	    asIso (pullback.map
    46	      (pullback.fst (iU ≫ f) g ≫ iU) iV
    47	      (pullback.snd g (iU ≫ f) ≫ iU) iV
    48	      (pullbackSymmetry (iU ≫ f) g).hom (𝟙 V) (𝟙 X)
    49	      (by simp) (by simp)) ≪≫
    50	    pullbackAssoc g (iU ≫ f) iU iV ≪≫
    51	    pullbackSymmetry g (pullback.fst iU iV ≫ (iU ≫ f)) ≪≫
    52	    asIso (pullback.map
    53	      (pullback.fst iU iV ≫ (iU ≫ f)) g
    54	      (a ≫ iU ≫ f) g
    55	      e.inv (𝟙 Y) (𝟙 Z)
    56	      (by
    57	        simpa only [Category.comp_id, Category.assoc] using
    58	          congrArg (fun q => q ≫ iU ≫ f) e_inv_fst.symm)
    59	      (by simp))
    60	
    61	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    62	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    63	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] [IsSepClosed k]
    64	
    65	namespace Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage
    66	
    67	set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 3200000 in
    68	set_option maxHeartbeats 12800000 in
    69	/-- The left overlap leg followed by the glued structure map is the affine
    70	structure morphism of the finite-stage overlap. -/
    71	theorem overlap_gluedMap
    72	    {F : Type u} [Field F] [Algebra F k] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F k]
    73	    (P : Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage C F)
    74	    (U V : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) :
    75	    P.glueData.f U V ≫ P.glueData.ι U ≫ P.gluedMap =
    76	      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
    77	        (algebraMap P.N.1
    78	          (Pic0FiniteStageOverlapBaseChangeRing
    79	            C P.L P.n P.m P.relation P.M P.N U V))) := by
    80	  let r := pic0FiniteStageRestrictionBaseChange
    81	    C P.L P.n P.m P.relation P.M P.mapM P.N U V
    82	  letI : Algebra
    83	      (Pic0FiniteStageChartBaseChangeRing
    84	        C P.L P.n P.m P.relation P.M P.N U)
    85	      (Pic0FiniteStageOverlapBaseChangeRing
    86	        C P.L P.n P.m P.relation P.M P.N U V) :=
    87	    pic0FiniteStageAlgebraOfMap r
    88	  letI : IsScalarTower P.N.1
    89	      (Pic0FiniteStageChartBaseChangeRing
    90	        C P.L P.n P.m P.relation P.M P.N U)
    91	      (Pic0FiniteStageOverlapBaseChangeRing
    92	        C P.L P.n P.m P.relation P.M P.N U V) :=
    93	    pic0FiniteStageTowerOfMap r
    94	  rw [Category.assoc, glueData_ι_gluedMap, glueData_f]
    95	  rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
    96	  congr 1
    97	  ext x
    98	  simp only [CommRingCat.ofHom_comp, CommRingCat.hom_comp,
    99	    ConcreteCategory.hom_ofHom, RingHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply,
   100	    AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingHom.coe_coe]
   101	  rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply P.N.1
   102	    (Pic0FiniteStageChartBaseChangeRing
   103	      C P.L P.n P.m P.relation P.M P.N U)
   104	    (Pic0FiniteStageOverlapBaseChangeRing
   105	      C P.L P.n P.m P.relation P.M P.N U V)]
   106	
   107	set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 3200000 in
   108	set_option maxHeartbeats 12800000 in
   109	/-- The overlap component comparing `Scheme.Pullback.gluing` with the exact
   110	separably closed atlas.  This is the component intended for the future
   111	`NatIso.ofComponents` comparing the two glue data. -/
   112	noncomputable def gluingOverlapBaseChangeIso
   113	    {F : Type u} [Field F] [Algebra F k] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F k]
   114	    (P : Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage C F)
   115	    (U V : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) :
   116	    (Scheme.Pullback.gluing P.glueData.openCover P.gluedMap
   117	      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.N.1 k)))).V (U, V) ≅
   118	      (pic0FiniteStageAffineOverlap C U V).1.toScheme :=
   119	  nestedPullbackFlatteningIso
   120	      (P.glueData.ι U) (P.glueData.ι V) P.gluedMap
   121	      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.N.1 k)))
   122	      (P.glueData.f U V) (P.glueData.t U V ≫ P.glueData.f V U)
   123	      (by simp) (P.glueData.vPullbackConeIsLimit U V) ≪≫
   124	    pullback.congrHom (overlap_gluedMap C P U V) rfl ≪≫
   125	    overlapBaseChangeIso C P U V
   126	
   127	end Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage
   128	
   129	end
   130	
   131	end AlgebraicGeometry

     6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0FiniteStageFinalBaseChange
     7	
     8	/-!
     9	# Base change of the finite-stage Picard charts
    10	
    11	Each chart inclusion in the finite-stage glue lies over its affine structure map.
    12	After extending from the final finite subextension to the separably closed field,
    13	the affine pullback formula and the final ring comparison identify that chart with
    14	the corresponding chart in the exact Picard atlas.
    15	-/
    16	
    17	set_option autoImplicit false
    18	
    19	universe u
    20	
    21	open CategoryTheory Limits TensorProduct
    22	open scoped TensorProduct
    23	
    24	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    25	
    26	noncomputable section
    27	
    28	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    29	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    30	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] [IsSepClosed k]
    31	
    32	namespace Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage
    33	
    34	set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 3200000 in
    35	-- Projecting the package retains the nested finite-subextension scalar towers.
    36	set_option maxHeartbeats 12800000 in
    37	/-- Every finite-stage chart inclusion lies over the chart's affine structure map. -/
    38	@[reassoc]
    39	theorem glueData_ι_gluedMap
    40	    {F : Type u} [Field F] [Algebra F k] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F k]
    41	    (P : Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage C F)
    42	    (U : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) :
    43	    P.glueData.ι U ≫ P.gluedMap =
    44	      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
    45	        (algebraMap P.N.1
    46	          (Pic0FiniteStageChartBaseChangeRing
    47	            C P.L P.n P.m P.relation P.M P.N U))) := by
    48	  unfold gluedMap
    49	  exact Multicoequalizer.π_desc _ _ _ _ _
    50	
    51	set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 3200000 in
    52	-- The composite infers the same nested tensor-product instances as the ring comparison.
    53	set_option maxHeartbeats 12800000 in
    54	/-- Base change of a finite-stage affine chart recovers the corresponding chart in the
    55	exact separably closed Picard atlas. -/
    56	noncomputable def chartBaseChangeIso
    57	    {F : Type u} [Field F] [Algebra F k] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F k]
    58	    (P : Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage C F)
    59	    (U : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) :
    60	    pullback
    61	        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
    62	          (algebraMap P.N.1
    63	            (Pic0FiniteStageChartBaseChangeRing
    64	              C P.L P.n P.m P.relation P.M P.N U))))
    65	        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.N.1 k))) ≅
    66	      (pic0SepClosedAtlasOpenCover C).X U :=
    67	  pullbackSymmetry _ _ ≪≫
    68	    pullbackSpecIso P.N.1 k
    69	      (Pic0FiniteStageChartBaseChangeRing
    70	        C P.L P.n P.m P.relation P.M P.N U) ≪≫
    71	    Scheme.Spec.mapIso
    72	      (pic0FiniteStageFinalBaseChangeEquiv
    73	        C P.L P.n P.m P.relation P.e P.M P.N
    74	          (Sum.inl U)).symm.toRingEquiv.toCommRingCatIso.op ≪≫
    75	    U.1.2.isoSpec.symm
    76	
    77	end Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage
    78	
    79	end
    80	
    81	end AlgebraicGeometry

1	/-

     6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0FiniteStageAffineBaseChange
     7	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0FiniteStageGluingBaseChange
     8	
     9	/-!
    10	# Naturality of finite-stage Picard restrictions after base change
    11	
    12	The restriction legs in a finite-stage glue package are affine morphisms over the
    13	final finite subextension.  Their pullbacks to the separably closed field agree,
    14	under the final ring comparisons, with the canonical restrictions in the exact
    15	Picard atlas.
    16	-/
    17	
    18	set_option autoImplicit false
    19	
    20	universe u
    21	
    22	open CategoryTheory Limits TensorProduct
    23	open scoped TensorProduct
    24	
    25	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    26	
    27	noncomputable section
    28	
    29	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    30	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    31	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] [IsSepClosed k]
    32	
    33	namespace Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage
    34	
    35	set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 3200000 in
    36	-- Projecting the package unfolds the dependent finite-subextension towers.
    37	set_option maxHeartbeats 12800000 in
    38	/-- The left restriction leg of the glue package is the spectrum of the
    39	scalar-extended descended restriction. -/
    40	theorem glueData_f
    41	    {F : Type u} [Field F] [Algebra F k] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F k]
    42	    (P : Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage C F)
    43	    (U V : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) :
    44	    P.glueData.f U V =
    45	      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
    46	        (pic0FiniteStageRestrictionBaseChange
    47	          C P.L P.n P.m P.relation P.M P.mapM P.N U V).toRingHom) := by
    48	  rfl
    49	
    50	set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 3200000 in
    51	-- The annotation fixes the source and target instances hidden by dependent indices.
    52	set_option maxHeartbeats 12800000 in
    53	/-- The scalar-extended descended restriction, with its chart and overlap types
    54	fixed opaquely for use by the affine base-change API. -/
    55	noncomputable def restrictionBaseChangeAlgHom
    56	    {F : Type u} [Field F] [Algebra F k] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F k]
    57	    (P : Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage C F)
    58	    (U V : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) :
    59	    Pic0FiniteStageChartBaseChangeRing
    60	        C P.L P.n P.m P.relation P.M P.N U →ₐ[P.N.1]
    61	      Pic0FiniteStageOverlapBaseChangeRing
    62	        C P.L P.n P.m P.relation P.M P.N U V :=
    63	  (pic0FiniteStageRestrictionBaseChange
    64	      C P.L P.n P.m P.relation P.M P.mapM P.N U V :
    65	    Pic0FiniteStageChartBaseChangeRing
    66	        C P.L P.n P.m P.relation P.M P.N U →ₐ[P.N.1]
    67	      Pic0FiniteStageOverlapBaseChangeRing
    68	        C P.L P.n P.m P.relation P.M P.N U V)
    69	
    70	/-- The exact left restriction with indexed source and target rings.  Keeping
    71	the indexed rings avoids relying on typeclass transparency for their aliases. -/
    72	noncomputable def exactRestrictionAlgHom
    73	    (U V : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) :
    74	    Pic0FiniteStageRing C (Sum.inl U) →ₐ[k]
    75	      Pic0FiniteStageRing C (Sum.inr (U, V)) :=
    76	  pic0FiniteStageMap C (Sum.inl (Sum.inl (U, V)))
    77	
    78	set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 3200000 in
    79	-- The annotation fixes the indexed exact-ring instance on the chart target.
    80	set_option maxHeartbeats 12800000 in
    81	/-- Final scalar-extension comparison for a chart, with an indexed exact-ring
    82	target. -/
    83	noncomputable def chartFinalBaseChangeEquiv
    84	    {F : Type u} [Field F] [Algebra F k] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F k]
    85	    (P : Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage C F)
    86	    (U : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) :
    87	    k ⊗[P.N.1]
    88	        Pic0FiniteStageChartBaseChangeRing
    89	          C P.L P.n P.m P.relation P.M P.N U ≃ₐ[k]
    90	      Pic0FiniteStageRing C (Sum.inl U) :=
    91	  pic0FiniteStageFinalBaseChangeEquiv
    92	    C P.L P.n P.m P.relation P.e P.M P.N (Sum.inl U)
    93	
    94	set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 3200000 in
    95	-- The annotation fixes the indexed exact-ring instance on the overlap target.
    96	set_option maxHeartbeats 12800000 in
    97	/-- Final scalar-extension comparison for an overlap, with an indexed
    98	exact-ring target. -/
    99	noncomputable def overlapFinalBaseChangeEquiv
   100	    {F : Type u} [Field F] [Algebra F k] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F k]
   101	    (P : Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage C F)
   102	    (U V : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) :

     3	/-- A family of gluing data consists of
     4	1. An index type `J`
     5	2. A scheme `U i` for each `i : J`.
     6	3. A scheme `V i j` for each `i j : J`.
     7	  (Note that this is `J × J → Scheme` rather than `J → J → Scheme` to connect to the
     8	  limits library easier.)
     9	4. An open immersion `f i j : V i j ⟶ U i` for each `i j : ι`.
    10	5. A transition map `t i j : V i j ⟶ V j i` for each `i j : ι`.
    11	
    12	such that
    13	6. `f i i` is an isomorphism.
    14	7. `t i i` is the identity.
    15	8. `V i j ×[U i] V i k ⟶ V i j ⟶ V j i` factors through `V j k ×[U j] V j i ⟶ V j i` via some
    16	    `t' : V i j ×[U i] V i k ⟶ V j k ×[U j] V j i`.
    17	9. `t' i j k ≫ t' j k i ≫ t' k i j = 𝟙 _`.
    18	
    19	We can then glue the schemes `U i` together by identifying `V i j` with `V j i`, such
    20	that the `U i`'s are open subschemes of the glued space.

    14	/-!
    15	# Fibred products of schemes
    16	
    17	In this file we construct the fibred product of schemes via gluing.
    18	We roughly follow [har77] Theorem 3.3.
    19	
    20	In particular, the main construction is to show that for an open cover `{ Uᵢ }` of `X`, if there
    21	exist fibred products `Uᵢ ×[Z] Y` for each `i`, then there exists a fibred product `X ×[Z] Y`.
    22	
    23	Then, for constructing the fibred product for arbitrary schemes `X, Y, Z`, we can use the
    24	construction to reduce to the case where `X, Y, Z` are all affine, where fibred products are
    25	constructed via tensor products.
    26	
    27	-/
    28	
    29	@[expose] public section
    30	
    31	
    32	universe u v w
    33	
    34	noncomputable section
    35	
    36	open CategoryTheory Functor CartesianMonoidalCategory Limits AlgebraicGeometry
    37	
    38	namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme
    39	
    40	namespace Pullback
    41	
    42	variable {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (𝒰 : OpenCover.{u} X) (f : X ⟶ Z) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    43	variable [∀ i, HasPullback (𝒰.f i ≫ f) g]
    44	
    45	/-- The intersection of `Uᵢ ×[Z] Y` and `Uⱼ ×[Z] Y` is given by (Uᵢ ×[Z] Y) ×[X] Uⱼ -/
    46	@[implicit_reducible]
    47	def v (i j : 𝒰.I₀) : Scheme :=
    48	  pullback ((pullback.fst (𝒰.f i ≫ f) g) ≫ 𝒰.f i) (𝒰.f j)
    49	
    50	/-- The canonical transition map `(Uᵢ ×[Z] Y) ×[X] Uⱼ ⟶ (Uⱼ ×[Z] Y) ×[X] Uᵢ` given by the fact
    51	that pullbacks are associative and symmetric. -/
    52	def t (i j : 𝒰.I₀) : v 𝒰 f g i j ⟶ v 𝒰 f g j i := by
    53	  have : HasPullback (pullback.snd _ _ ≫ 𝒰.f i ≫ f) g :=
    54	    hasPullback_assoc_symm (𝒰.f j) (𝒰.f i) (𝒰.f i ≫ f) g
    55	  have : HasPullback (pullback.snd _ _ ≫ 𝒰.f j ≫ f) g :=
    56	    hasPullback_assoc_symm (𝒰.f i) (𝒰.f j) (𝒰.f j ≫ f) g
    57	  refine (pullbackSymmetry ..).hom ≫ (pullbackAssoc ..).inv ≫ ?_

    63	@[simp, reassoc]

    65	    pullback.snd _ _ := by
    66	  simp only [t, Category.assoc, pullbackSymmetry_hom_comp_fst_assoc, pullbackAssoc_hom_snd_fst,
    67	    pullback.lift_fst_assoc, pullbackSymmetry_hom_comp_snd, pullbackAssoc_inv_fst_fst,
    68	    pullbackSymmetry_hom_comp_fst]

    78	    pullback.fst _ _ ≫ pullback.fst _ _ := by

    81	    pullbackSymmetry_hom_comp_snd_assoc]

    36	/-- A gluing datum consists of
    37	1. An index type `J`
    38	2. An object `U i` for each `i : J`.
    39	3. An object `V i j` for each `i j : J`.
    40	4. A monomorphism `f i j : V i j ⟶ U i` for each `i j : J`.
    41	5. A transition map `t i j : V i j ⟶ V j i` for each `i j : J`.
    42	
    43	such that
    44	6. `f i i` is an isomorphism.
    45	7. `t i i` is the identity.
    46	8. The pullback for `f i j` and `f i k` exists.
    47	9. `V i j ×[U i] V i k ⟶ V i j ⟶ V j i` factors through `V j k ×[U j] V j i ⟶ V j i` via some
    48	    `t' : V i j ×[U i] V i k ⟶ V j k ×[U j] V j i`.
    49	10. `t' i j k ≫ t' j k i ≫ t' k i j = 𝟙 _`.
    50	-/
    51	structure GlueData where
    52	  /-- The index type `J` of a gluing datum -/
    53	  J : Type v
    54	  /-- For each `i : J`, an object `U i` -/
    55	  U : J → C
    56	  /-- For each `i j : J`, an object `V i j` -/
    57	  V : J × J → C
    58	  /-- For each `i j : J`, a monomorphism `f i j : V i j ⟶ U i` -/
    59	  f : ∀ i j, V (i, j) ⟶ U i
    60	  f_mono : ∀ i j, Mono (f i j) := by infer_instance
    61	  f_hasPullback : ∀ i j k, HasPullback (f i j) (f i k) := by infer_instance
    62	  f_id : ∀ i, IsIso (f i i) := by infer_instance
    63	  /-- For each `i j : J`, a transition map `t i j : V i j ⟶ V j i` -/
    64	  t : ∀ i j, V (i, j) ⟶ V (j, i)
    65	  t_id : ∀ i, t i i = 𝟙 _
    66	  /-- The morphism via which `V i j ×[U i] V i k ⟶ V i j ⟶ V j i` factors through
    67	  `V j k ×[U j] V j i ⟶ V j i` -/
    68	  t' : ∀ i j k, pullback (f i j) (f i k) ⟶ pullback (f j k) (f j i)
    69	  t_fac : ∀ i j k, t' i j k ≫ pullback.snd _ _ = pullback.fst _ _ ≫ t i j
    70	  cocycle : ∀ i j k, t' i j k ≫ t' j k i ≫ t' k i j = 𝟙 _
    71	
    72	attribute [simp] GlueData.t_id
    73	
    74	attribute [instance] GlueData.f_id GlueData.f_mono GlueData.f_hasPullback
    75	
    76	attribute [reassoc] GlueData.t_fac GlueData.cocycle
    77	
    78	namespace GlueData
    79	
    80	variable {C}
    81	variable (D : GlueData C)
    82	
    83	@[simp]
    84	theorem t'_iij (i j : D.J) : D.t' i i j = (pullbackSymmetry _ _).hom := by
    85	  have eq₁ := D.t_fac i i j
    86	  have eq₂ := (IsIso.eq_comp_inv (D.f i i)).mpr (@pullback.condition _ _ _ _ _ _ (D.f i j) _)
    87	  rw [D.t_id, Category.comp_id, eq₂] at eq₁
    88	  have eq₃ := (IsIso.eq_comp_inv (D.f i i)).mp eq₁
    89	  rw [Category.assoc, ← pullback.condition, ← Category.assoc] at eq₃
    90	  exact
    91	    Mono.right_cancellation _ _
    92	      ((Mono.right_cancellation _ _ eq₃).trans (pullbackSymmetry_hom_comp_fst _ _).symm)
    93	
    94	theorem t'_jii (i j : D.J) : D.t' j i i = pullback.fst _ _ ≫ D.t j i ≫ inv (pullback.snd _ _) := by
    95	  rw [← Category.assoc, ← D.t_fac]
    96	  simp
    97	
    98	theorem t'_iji (i j : D.J) : D.t' i j i = pullback.fst _ _ ≫ D.t i j ≫ inv (pullback.snd _ _) := by
    99	  rw [← Category.assoc, ← D.t_fac]
   100	  simp
   101	
   102	@[reassoc, elementwise (attr := simp)]
   103	theorem t_inv (i j : D.J) : D.t i j ≫ D.t j i = 𝟙 _ := by
   104	  have eq : (pullbackSymmetry (D.f i i) (D.f i j)).hom =
   105	      pullback.snd _ _ ≫ inv (pullback.fst _ _) := by simp
   106	  have := D.cocycle i j i
   107	  rw [D.t'_iij, D.t'_jii, D.t'_iji, fst_eq_snd_of_mono_eq, eq] at this
   108	  simp only [Category.assoc, IsIso.inv_hom_id_assoc] at this
   109	  rw [← IsIso.eq_inv_comp, ← Category.assoc, IsIso.comp_inv_eq] at this
   110	  simpa using this
   111	
   112	theorem t'_inv (i j k : D.J) :
   113	    D.t' i j k ≫ (pullbackSymmetry _ _).hom ≫ D.t' j i k ≫ (pullbackSymmetry _ _).hom = 𝟙 _ := by
   114	  rw [← cancel_mono (pullback.fst (D.f i j) (D.f i k))]
   115	  simp [t_fac, t_fac_assoc]
   116	
   117	instance t_isIso (i j : D.J) : IsIso (D.t i j) :=
   118	  ⟨⟨D.t j i, D.t_inv _ _, D.t_inv _ _⟩⟩
   119	
   120	instance t'_isIso (i j k : D.J) : IsIso (D.t' i j k) :=
   121	  ⟨⟨D.t' j k i ≫ D.t' k i j, D.cocycle _ _ _, by simpa using D.cocycle _ _ _⟩⟩
   122	
   123	@[reassoc]
   124	theorem t'_comp_eq_pullbackSymmetry (i j k : D.J) :
   125	    D.t' j k i ≫ D.t' k i j =
   126	      (pullbackSymmetry _ _).hom ≫ D.t' j i k ≫ (pullbackSymmetry _ _).hom := by
   127	  trans inv (D.t' i j k)
   128	  · exact IsIso.eq_inv_of_hom_inv_id (D.cocycle _ _ _)
   129	  · rw [← cancel_mono (pullback.fst (D.f i j) (D.f i k))]
   130	    simp [t_fac, t_fac_assoc]
   131	
   132	/-- (Implementation) The disjoint union of `U i`. -/
   133	def sigmaOpens [HasCoproduct D.U] : C :=
   134	  ∐ D.U
   135	
   136	/-- (Implementation) The diagram to take colimit of. -/
   137	def diagram : MultispanIndex (.prod D.J) C where
   138	  left := D.V
   139	  right := D.U
   140	  fst := fun ⟨i, j⟩ => D.f i j
   141	  snd := fun ⟨i, j⟩ => D.t i j ≫ D.f j i
   142	
   143	@[simp]
   144	theorem diagram_fst (i j : D.J) : D.diagram.fst ⟨i, j⟩ = D.f i j :=
   145	  rfl
   146	
   147	@[simp]
   148	theorem diagram_snd (i j : D.J) : D.diagram.snd ⟨i, j⟩ = D.t i j ≫ D.f j i :=
   149	  rfl
   150	
   151	@[simp]
   152	theorem diagram_left : D.diagram.left = D.V :=
   153	  rfl
   154	
   155	@[simp]
   156	theorem diagram_right : D.diagram.right = D.U :=
   157	  rfl

   162	
   163	/-- The glued object given a family of gluing data. -/

   165	  multicoequalizer D.diagram
   166

   168	def ι (i : D.J) : D.U i ⟶ D.glued :=
   169	  Multicoequalizer.π D.diagram i

   173	  (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans (Multicoequalizer.condition D.diagram ⟨i, j⟩).symm
   174

import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0GaloisInvariantMatch

/-!
# Conditional finite-Galois representability for Picard zero

This is a conditional producer: it descends a finite-level representative only
under the explicitly supplied orbit-in-an-affine-open instance.  It is not the
arbitrary-field representability endpoint.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite
open AlgebraicGeometry
open AlgebraicJacobian.GaloisDescent

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

noncomputable section

variable {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]

/-- Conditional finite-Galois descent of a finite-level Picard-zero representative.

The orbit-in-an-affine-open instance is the sole extra descent hypothesis here;
this theorem does not claim arbitrary-field representability.
-/
noncomputable def pic0RepresentableBy_finiteGaloisDescent
    (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]
    {J : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of L))}
    (rep : (pic0TypeFunctor ((baseChange K L).obj C)).RepresentableBy J)
    [((pic0SemilinearGalActionOfRepresentableBy C rep).OrbitsInAffineOpen)] :
    (pic0TypeFunctor C).RepresentableBy
      (AlgebraicJacobian.GaloisDescent.StableAffineOpen.gluedQuotientOver
        (pic0SemilinearGalActionOfRepresentableBy C rep)) where
  homEquiv {T} :=
    ((StableAffineOpen.gluedQuotientOverHomEquiv
      (pic0SemilinearGalActionOfRepresentableBy C rep) T).trans
      (pic0GaloisInvariantEquivGaloisEquivariantOver C rep T).symm).trans
      (pic0GaloisInvariantEquiv (L := L) C T).symm
  homEquiv_comp {T T'} f v := by
    apply (pic0GaloisInvariantEquiv (L := L) C T).injective
    apply (pic0GaloisInvariantEquivGaloisEquivariantOver C rep T).injective
    simp only [Equiv.trans_apply, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
    rw [StableAffineOpen.gluedQuotientOverHomEquiv_precomp]
    rw [pic0GaloisInvariantEquiv_precomp]
    rw [pic0GaloisInvariantEquivGaloisEquivariantOver_precomp]
    simp only [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]

end

end AlgebraicGeometry
